questions.text: What does make decisions print when nothing is open and DECISION_BUDGET is 0?

options.A: within budget: budget reached needs at least one open point, so a budget of 0 stops every point but never blocks a launch
options.B: budget reached: 0 open points equal a budget of 0, so no role launches while the budget is 0

questions.text: Does make decisions N=<n> write the issue dump itself?

options.A: yes, as make route-findings does (needs gh), so it never reads a stale dump
options.B: no, it reads the dump make settings N=<n> wrote and refuses a missing one

questions.text: How strict is an open entry beyond the criteria?

options.A: strict: a stop point may not carry a rollback, each question offers at least two options lettered A, B, ... and questions are q1, q2, ... in order
options.B: lenient: only what the criteria name is refused

rollback: q1: drop the total > 0 test in budget_state of agent-kit/scripts/decisions.py, its docstring and the formats.md line; q2: drop the two dump lines of the decisions target in Makefile and agent-kit/templates/Makefile.mk and the fake-gh make test; q3: remove those refusals from check_open and check_questions and their test cases

questions.text: F-204-7: no role is told to log a stop point's open entry; how is it handled?

options.B: log it and file a follow-up issue
